summary: Planban 1.0.3 restores cold launcher startup when PLANBAN_HOME is unset while retaining the verified-URL browser boundary introduced in 1.0.2.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban, verify the plugin and MCP tools are available, then confirm /pb returns a verified board link whether or not automatic in-app opening is available.
changelogSummary: Planban now starts cleanly from a stopped service with the default local home and still preserves verified board URLs across Browser presentation failures.
